subject: Tournaments
author: Jinno Angelo
body:
Yeah, most people dont realize that it takes a lot of planning for everything to work out. Most of the time a lot of things dont ever work cause there's just too many variables that you could not control. Just take a look at what happened during the last tourney. I had to cancel that because so many people couldnt make it.

You are right about one thing and you as well as I know that it the work that one puts into it will show how much youve done to get it right. People will always complain about stuff regardless of what you do, and sometimes it just gets to me. Sometimes, but not everytime.

The process is for everyone to use. Ive always said that because the point was to have as much tournaments without me just hosting it. I do have other things to attend to on a day to day basis. I wanted to have other players host it as well and to add their touches to it, because you never know a really good format could come out of it.

I really have no idea where this whole elitist stuff came from ini my tournaments. Its true that I did invite fast racers, because I wanted a really fast room. No doubt about that, but I have opened up spots for other racers for the last two tournaments. The first one was special invite only, but the other two wasnt. Zombs entered which was a good thing. So im hoping, really hoping that others will follow in her steps soon. That way we could have a good tourney next time.

I do think my tourneys are in haitus right now. I havent found time to do things lately and if I were to host one up, I would definitely need a co-planner with me so that we could get the word out more when Im not around in XBL. That would definitely help me out as that would create a second host as well. Maybe well have one soon. Im still disheartened that the last one was cancelled and that may just be a sign for me telling me that Revenge is out?? Who knows because there are still people playing the game. They are however the hard core Burnout Revengers now...

 

------------------------------------------------

subject: Eletist?
author: oO EezO Oo
body:
I like your ideas Cog.  The comments I assume you may have gotten about 'unspoken fast racers only rule' and 'eletism' kinda irk me.  I think you did a great job with your tourneys and calling it Elitist overshadows alot of the work and planning you put into it.  I think from the very beginning you stated what you wanted as an outcome for your tourneys and I think you accomplished that.  You wanted a fast tourney of the fastest Revenge racers.  Not everyone is gonna fit into that category.  You came up with alot of new ideas that streamlined the whole process.  If anyone ever wants to run a tourney, they would benefit greatly by reading through your format.

subject: An Idea
author: Jinno Angelo
body:
2 weeks of Races:

1st week: F, or S, or Su

Burnout Revenge Races... points acrue to be used in 2nd week Tourney

 

2nd week: F, S, or Su

Burnout Pardise Races.. points earned are added to previous point in revenge Tourney.

This way, we all get to play an All-Encompassing Burnout Tourney, not restricted to one game but applies to both games so that people who are good in one game may not be good in another, vice versa.. Should make for some interesting matches and challenges..

Of course the set up for the Revenge should be as like previous Revenge tournaments and I have not touched my Paradise game so I wouldnt know how to set that one up, someone else may need to take that up.

Of course all player entering should have both games?? It would only make sense to either have it or rent it if one needs to enter. And this could be done in a day's time frame rather than two, but the set up must be changed to determine that.. Of course two days would always be better as it would probably make for a less hectic schedule..
